researcher_notes:
COMPANY CONFIRMED REAL. Addverb Technologies Ltd. — HQ: Addverb Bot-Valley, Plot No. 5, Sector-156, Phase-II, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310, India. Founded 2016 (CIN U74999UP2016PLC122944, per addverb.com/about-us). ~1,000+ employees, 10 global offices, 350+ clients, 500+ warehouses automated (self-reported, About Us page). Second facility 'Bot-Verse' in Greater Noida (manufacturing/development centre).

PRODUCT-LINE CLASSIFICATION REASONING
Addverb's site groups products into: Mobile Robots | Sorting Robots | ASRS | Picking Systems | Software | Conveyors and more. ONLY the 'Mobile Robots' category contains genuine floor-roaming AGV/AMR vehicles. That category contains exactly four product lines:
  1. Dynamo — Autonomous Mobile Robot (6 payload variants: 100/200/500/1000/1500/2500 kg). Natural-navigation (SLAM) platform AMR. IN SCOPE.
  2. FlowT — Autonomous Forklift (2 variants: FlowT 1000 ground-to-ground pallet truck; FlowT 1530/1520 ground-to-2000 mm stacker). IN SCOPE (Forklift AGV).
  3. Dash — Assembly Line Robot (2 variants: Dash Line chassis carrier; Dash Tug underride trolley tugger). QR/ground-marker guided floor AGVs. IN SCOPE.
  4. Veloce — Multi-Carton Picking Robot (ACR). Floor-roaming, QR-grid guided, drives warehouse aisles and telescopes totes into/out of racking up to 3.6 m. IN SCOPE as Mobile AMR (comparable to Hai Robotics HAIPICK / Geek+ C-series). NOT rack-integrated — it is a free-roaming floor robot with a mast.

EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED (verified not floor pallet/load-transport AGV/AMR):
  - Zippy (Robotic Sorter) and Vertical Sortation Robot — grid-mounted parcel sortation bots on a dedicated sorting deck, not load transport vehicles.
  - Cruiser 360 / 4-Way Pallet Shuttle, 2-Way Pallet Shuttle, Mother-Child Shuttle, Carton Shuttle, Multi Level Shuttle, Crane ASRS — all rail/rack-integrated ASRS.
  - Rail Guided Vehicle — rail-bound, not free-roaming.
  - Conveyors, Vertical Lifts, Horizontal Carousel, Pick-to-Light — fixed automation.
  - WMS / WES / WCS / Fleet Management System — software only.
  - 'Quadron': NOT found anywhere on the current addverb.com product tree (checked Products Overview + Mobile Robots category, 2026-08). Either discontinued or renamed. No record created.

DATA SOURCES: All numeric values come from Addverb's own downloadable datasheet PDFs (linked from each product page via the hidden 'pdfurl' input) plus the product pages themselves. Variant pages are POST-driven (form_pdt_id); each variant was fetched individually. Datasheet URLs are recorded per product in 'datasheet_url'.

CROSS-CUTTING FLAGS / CONFLICTS:
  - FlowT NAMING CONFLICT: the product page variant selector says 'FlowT 1530'; the datasheet it links to is titled 'FlowT 1520'. Same specs. Recorded as 'FlowT 1530' with the discrepancy flagged.
  - FlowT 1000 payload: product page headline says 'Payload (kg) 1000, 2000' and the FlowT intro text says 'up to 2,000 kg', but the FlowT 1000 datasheet says 1000 kg. Recorded conservatively as 1000.
  - Dash Tug payload: product page says 1800 kg, datasheet says 2,000 kg. Recorded conservatively as 1800.
  - Dynamo 2500 speed: product page says 'Up to 0.8 m/s'; datasheet says '1.2 m/s (empty) / 0.8 m/s (loaded)'. Recorded 1.2 (datasheet max) with the loaded figure noted.
  - Dynamo 2500 drive: product page tech table says 'Drive type Differential', datasheet says 'Drive Omni-directional Drive'. CONFLICT — omnidirectional_movement left NULL for the 2500.
  - Charging time convention: Addverb quotes Dynamo/Veloce charge time on a 20–80% basis (8 min); the Dynamo datasheets also give 24 min for 0–80%. The 20–80% figure is used here for consistency with the vendor's own headline and with FlowT (which is also quoted 20–80%). Flagged per product.
  - Battery chemistry: Addverb uses LTO (lithium titanate) on most models and LiFePO4 on some. LTO is mapped to 'Li-Ion' since AP0 has no LTO value. Where the datasheet says 'LiFePO4/LTO' both values are recorded.
  - vda5050_compatible: NO evidence found either way. Addverb never mentions VDA 5050 in any datasheet, product page, or press material located. Left NULL — deliberately NOT set to false.
  - functional_safety_level (PLd/PLe/SIL): never published by Addverb. Left NULL on all products.
  - operating temperature / humidity / gradient: only Veloce publishes a temperature range (+5 to +45 °C). All other models: NULL.
  - max_fleet_size / multi_fleet_capable: not published for any product. NULL.
  - NO VNA PRODUCT: Addverb has no VNA/turret truck in its portfolio. FlowT 1000's published min aisle is 2200 mm. vna_capable set false on both forklifts.
  - industries_served: Addverb lists Automotive & Tyre, Consumer Goods, Grocery, Solar & Battery, Chemicals & Petrochemicals, E-Commerce, Pharmaceuticals, Third Party Logistics, Cold Storage, Fashion, Semiconductors. NOT written into the field because the AP0 allowed-value list for industries_served was not verified in this session — populate manually from this list.
